title: Approaches for Achieving Superlubricity in Two-Dimensional Materials

extraction_issues.quote: Dietzel et al97, analyzed the limitations of structural superblubricity by measuring sliding friction of differently sized antimony particles on MoS2 and HOPG substrates.
extraction_issues.reason: 上下文中'structural superlubricity'应为'structural superlubricity'，此处拼写为'superblubricity'，但原文如此，保留原样并标记。
